setup: Local HTTPS fixture serves release A, switches to generated release B, and proxies authenticated API requests to noema.kevinpei.com.

results.check: Release B installed before safe activation
Release B update activates and preserves draft

command: openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -subj '/CN=noema.kevinpei.com' -keyout /var/tmp/noema-pwa-fixture.key -out /var/tmp/noema-pwa-fixture.crt -days 1 && (cd apps/web && NOEMA_PWA_RELEASE=pwa-a NOEMA_DEV_ASSET_DIR=/var/tmp/noema-pwa-release-a bun run build:web-assets && NOEMA_PWA_RELEASE=pwa-b NOEMA_DEV_ASSET_DIR=/var/tmp/noema-pwa-release-b bun run build:web-assets) && bun docs/validation/evidence/2026-09-06-pwa-two-release.mjs

scope: Controlled Chromium PWA update. Physical installation and public edge cache behavior remain outside this check.
